final_answer:
### Status of Support Request `CC-9999-99999`

**Problem:**  
The support request reference **CC-9999-99999** could not be found in the system.

---

### What to Do Next

1. **Verify the Reference Number:**  
   Check your records or confirmation emails to ensure the reference number was typed correctly (valid CoCIS support reference formats typically reflect the year, e.g., `CC-2026-XXXXX`).

2. **Contact CoCIS Administration Directly:**  
   If you cannot find the correct reference number or require urgent assistance, you can reach out to the college through official channels:
   * **Email:** `info@cis.mak.ac.ug`, `principal.cis@mak.ac.ug`, or `pr.cis@mak.ac.ug` [Sources: *CoCIS-Prospectus-2023-2024.pdf*, page 64; *CoCIS-Annual-Report-2020-2022.pdf*, page 67]
   * **Telephone:** +256 414 540 628 / +256 414 534 560 [Sources: *CoCIS-Prospectus-2023-2024.pdf*, page 64; *CoCIS-Annual-Report-2020-2022.pdf*, page 67]
   * **Website:** [www.cis.mak.ac.ug](https://www.cis.mak.ac.ug) [Sources: *CoCIS-Prospectus-2023-2024.pdf*, page 64; *CoCIS-Annual-Report-2020-2022.pdf*, page 67]

*(Note: In accordance with your instruction, no new request has been created or submitted.)*
